text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both slightly down over 24 hours, with BTC showing slightly more weakness, while the Fear & Greed Index at 27 signals genuine market fear despite a modest 2-point weekly improvement. Bitcoin dominance at 56.5% suggests traders are rotating modestly into altcoins, though total volume of $50B remains moderate for the current price levels. The mixed performance across major assets—with defensive plays like BNB holding steadier while growth-correlated assets like SOL lag—points to cautious positioning rather than panic selling.
